targets.expr: sum by (site_name,hostname) ((rate(ifHCInOctets{job="network_snmp",role="wireless_controller",site_name=~"$site",vendor=~"$vendor",hostname=~"$device"}[5m]) or rate(ifInOctets{job="network_snmp",role="wireless_controller",site_name=~"$site",vendor=~"$vendor",hostname=~"$device"}[5m])) * on(instance, ifIndex) group_left(ifName, ifAlias) (((max by (instance, ifIndex, ifName) (ifName{job="network_snmp",role="wireless_controller",site_name=~"$site",vendor=~"$vendor",hostname=~"$device",ifName!=""} * 0 + 1)) * on(instance, ifIndex) group_left(ifAlias) (max by (instance, ifIndex, ifAlias) (ifAlias{job="network_snmp",role="wireless_controller",site_name=~"$site",vendor=~"$vendor",hostname=~"$device"} * 0 + 1))) or on(instance, ifIndex) (max by (instance, ifIndex, ifName) (ifName{job="network_snmp",role="wireless_controller",site_name=~"$site",vendor=~"$vendor",hostname=~"$device",ifName!=""} * 0 + 1))) and on(instance, ifIndex) (ifAdminStatus{job="network_snmp",role="wireless_controller",site_name=~"$site",vendor=~"$vendor",hostname=~"$device",ifName!=""} == 1) and on(instance, ifIndex) (ifOperStatus{job="network_snmp",role="wireless_controller",site_name=~"$site",vendor=~"$vendor",hostname=~"$device",ifName!=""} == 1)) * 8

sum by (site_name,hostname) ((rate(ifHCOutOctets{job="network_snmp",role="wireless_controller",site_name=~"$site",vendor=~"$vendor",hostname=~"$device"}[5m]) or rate(ifOutOctets{job="network_snmp",role="wireless_controller",site_name=~"$site",vendor=~"$vendor",hostname=~"$device"}[5m])) * on(instance, ifIndex) group_left(ifName, ifAlias) (((max by (instance, ifIndex, ifName) (ifName{job="network_snmp",role="wireless_controller",site_name=~"$site",vendor=~"$vendor",hostname=~"$device",ifName!=""} * 0 + 1)) * on(instance, ifIndex) group_left(ifAlias) (max by (instance, ifIndex, ifAlias) (ifAlias{job="network_snmp",role="wireless_controller",site_name=~"$site",vendor=~"$vendor",hostname=~"$device"} * 0 + 1))) or on(instance, ifIndex) (max by (instance, ifIndex, ifName) (ifName{job="network_snmp",role="wireless_controller",site_name=~"$site",vendor=~"$vendor",hostname=~"$device",ifName!=""} * 0 + 1))) and on(instance, ifIndex) (ifAdminStatus{job="network_snmp",role="wireless_controller",site_name=~"$site",vendor=~"$vendor",hostname=~"$device",ifName!=""} == 1) and on(instance, ifIndex) (ifOperStatus{job="network_snmp",role="wireless_controller",site_name=~"$site",vendor=~"$vendor",hostname=~"$device",ifName!=""} == 1)) * 8
